description: The MUTra-CDMX team publishes version 4.0 of five-minute traffic and weather observations for 20 adjoining road segments along 14.72 kilometres of Insurgentes Sur in Mexico City. The Zenodo record describes 691,200 segment–timestamp rows from 1 November 2024 to 28 February 2025, with speed, travel time and hourly weather values. It flags 8,936 reconstructed rows and preserves 682,264 original observations. Separate CSV files describe road geometry, points of interest and segment adjacency. The named RAR package is openly listed under CC BY 4.0 and no download fee is shown. These inputs can calibrate travel-time forecasting, congestion or network-operation simulations for an urban corridor. Coverage is limited to this corridor and period. Weather is repeated across five-minute rows; its hourly precipitation totals must not be summed twelve times. TomTom supplied traffic observations, and the article explicitly directs users to separate third-party data conditions in the package. Their effect on downstream reuse remains unresolved without inspecting the archive, which was not downloaded. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
